sway 1.9 IPC replies, captured (not reconstructed) from the headless sway
1.9 (wlroots 0.17) of the dev container on 2026-10-07: `swaymsg -t
get_tree -r` and `swaymsg -t get_workspaces -r` with one output
(HEADLESS-1, 1920x1080) and one xdg toplevel (app_id `foot`, title
`TITLE_HERE`) mapped by the tests' TestWindow client
(tests/common/window.rs).

tests/sway.rs's fake sway serves these over the i3-ipc framing and puts
raw Latin-1 bytes where `TITLE_HERE` is, as sway's json-c output does for
an XWayland window whose WM_NAME is of type STRING (wlroots copies it
byte for byte; json-c escapes only control characters, quotes and `/`).
